newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's bank turnover up to $13.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's bank turnover up to $13.6 mln.

text.p: Moroccan-Spanish UNIBAN Bank showed a slight rise of 0.4 percent to 119 million dirhams ($13.6 million) in turnover in the first half of the year, compared with the same period in 1995.

One of the eight Moroccan banks listed on the Casablanca stock market, Union Bancaria Hispano Marroqui (UNIBAN) registered a turnover of 118.5 million dirhams from January to June 1995, its balance sheet, published on Friday, showed.
Net profits dropped to 0.7 million dirhams in the first half of 1996 from 19.9 million dirhams in the same period last year.
With headquarters established in Casablanca, the bank has a capital of 246.4 million dirhams and reserves of 129 million dirhams.
Stockbrokers said UNIBAN remained a non-liquid stock, last being traded at 139 dirhams.
